sanskrit: kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam ||
vāntvā viśvaṃ grastaviśvāstāḥ kālyāḥ kavalaḥ sakṛt ||
ganthi cakka ādhāra vidhārana sā nekarūpa akkai vijayūna || 4 ||
khacarīcakka phuri yasa hanti so akka mahāthu jayi aniketu || 5 ||
lolo liṅgaparaḥ kṣudro na mahārthasya bhājanam ||
yugmā uditu sadāśivaruccī so viśvabīja nādasa ugghātu || 1 ||
īśarū śabda arthu jana pāne iha cetanakattiku icchāsaggu || 2 ||
paranabha icchā cida kamu casyo isa - u bhūtavyoma apabodhu || 3 ||
icchānantaru ñānu ce niṣkalu yavyu avataranda mahabhūtamayamba || 4 ||
(P. 31) ubhaya nippariśā pāvaku vapayo sedu salila āśāñī bhūma || 5 ||
ghanakalilapeśīrūpābhiḥ krameṇa poṣitāḥ satyo garbhatāṃ dadhate || 5 ||
te ye rāta hale paru dinne gaṇḍāgaṇḍathiyya itāya || 6 ||
nabhurā pañca akku akārusu ehuya siṣṭi pasaru ākalati ||
phaha loyanahaṭhapāko jaṭharaju pāna koṣṭha mukha śruti hadannāsa || 7 ||
udayisadattasamāñī samarasa kamakampana tasa tasa anurūpa || 2 ||
sṛṣṭiḥ sā paramā cādyā vyāpinīti nigadyate ||
prastūyate, sa coktavat ādyena saha caturdhā mahākramaḥ paribhāṣyate || 3 ||
saṃhāre conmanā jñeyā śaktirādyā tu sarvagā ||
upadiṣṭaḥ sa kathamanyathābhavitum arhati? - iti yathoktameva jyāyaḥ || 4 ||
te ye ubhayalokaśubhamaṅgala nija parāna advayubhāveta || 8 ||
yāgu uḍḍa anubhava parikalane tatha āvaṭha pañcana ku apalāpu || 1 ||
jaṅgamāna jānau pīṭhapano cinmaya yonadyu liṅgu śirāna || 2 ||
vitticakku todaśami galane e pīṭhi tina miśāna yasandu || 3 ||
